release_notes:
- Add license control system with activation dialog on startup
- Live license re-validation: admin can disable/ban a key and the tool closes within seconds
- Designed disabled/banned dialogs shown when a license is revoked or reopened
- New web admin dashboard (Supabase) to create, disable, enable, ban and manage licenses in real time
- Add license status indicator and Account info to the title bar
- Add Contact button to license dialogs
- Replace emoji with FontAwesome icons in license UI
